settings.title: Settings
concurrency.adminOnly: Concurrency settings are managed by the Admin. You don't have access to this page.
concurrency.about.label: About concurrency
concurrency.about.content: How many project containers may run at once, and how much memory each may use.
concurrency.intro: Containers start on demand when an agent run or the assistant needs one, and stop after sitting idle. These limits bound what a burst of agent activity can take on this machine.
concurrency.maxContainers.label: Maximum active containers
concurrency.maxContainers.point.scope: How many project containers may run at the same time, including the assistant's.
concurrency.maxContainers.point.queue: A run that needs another container waits in the queue until one goes idle. The assistant always starts.
concurrency.maxContainers.point.automati: On automatic, Hezo sizes this from host memory and keeps {reserved} GB free for the system.
concurrency.maxContainers.formulaAuto: Automatic: {ram} GB RAM + {swap} GB swap = {total} GB, less {reserved} GB for the system = {usable} GB / {cap} GB per container = {result}.
concurrency.maxContainers.formulaSet: Set explicitly. The automatic value for this host would be {value}.
concurrency.ramCap.label: RAM cap per container (GB)
concurrency.ramCap.point.limit: The memory limit applied to every project container.
concurrency.ramCap.point.overCap: A container that grows past the cap is stopped instead of taking down the server.
concurrency.ramCap.point.divisor: It also divides host memory into the automatic limit above, so a higher cap means fewer containers.
concurrency.ramCap.point.override: Projects that need more can override it in their own settings.
concurrency.ramCap.point.range: Whole number from {min} to {max}. Defaults to {default}.
concurrency.idleTimeout.label: Container idle timeout (minutes)
concurrency.idleTimeout.point.duration: How long a container keeps running after its last agent run or assistant activity.
concurrency.idleTimeout.point.restart: It starts again on demand the moment a run or a chat needs it.
concurrency.idleTimeout.point.servers: Stopping a container also stops any dev or preview servers inside it.
concurrency.idleTimeout.point.range: Whole number from {min} to {max}. Defaults to {default}, and 0 keeps containers always on.
concurrency.rangeError: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
